description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for testing persistence actors related to "things" in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes setup methods, mock data creation, and utility functions to support unit tests for persistence components.

classes.name: PersistenceActorTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing setup, utility functions, and mocks for testing persistence actors in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: TestedMethodLoggingWatcher
classes.description: A custom JUnit TestWatcher that logs the name of each test method being executed.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Static method to initialize shared test configuration and thing configuration.

methods.name: getThingConfig
methods.description: Creates a ThingConfig instance from the provided test configuration.

methods.name: createDittoHeadersMock
methods.description: Creates mock DittoHeaders with specified JSON schema version and authorization subjects.

methods.name: createThingV2WithRandomId
methods.description: Creates a Thing object with a random UUID-based ID for version 2.

methods.name: createThingV2WithId
methods.description: Creates a Thing object with the specified ThingId for version 2.

methods.name: createThingV1WithRandomId
methods.description: Creates a Thing object with a random ID for version 1.

methods.name: createThingV1WithId
methods.description: Creates a Thing object with the specified ID for version 1.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the actor system, test probes, and mock headers, optionally with custom configuration.

methods.name: tearDownBase
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test.

methods.name: createPersistenceActorFor
methods.description: Creates a persistence actor for a specific ThingId.

methods.name: createPersistenceActorWithPubSubFor
methods.description: Creates a persistence actor with a given pub/sub mediator for a specific ThingId.

methods.name: getPropsOfThingPersistenceActor
methods.description: Returns actor Props for a persistence actor, given ThingId and pub/sub mediator.

methods.name: createSupervisorActorFor
methods.description: Creates a supervisor actor for a specific ThingId.

methods.name: disableLogging
methods.description: Disables logging output for the actor system (useful for cleaner test output).

methods.name: getDistributedPub
methods.description: Returns a test implementation of the DistributedPub interface.

methods.name: TestPub
methods.description: Inner class implementing DistributedPub for testing purposes, wrapping published messages.
